# QR Vibe

> QR Vibe (https://qrvibe.online) is a free online QR code generator with logo. It makes branded, scan-tested QR codes for websites, WhatsApp, Wi-Fi, business cards (vCard), email, text, SMS, phone calls, locations, calendar events, social media profiles and crypto wallets. No sign-up, no watermark, and codes never expire because they are static. Everything runs in the browser, so logos and Wi-Fi passwords are never uploaded.

## Key facts
- Price: 100% free, unlimited downloads
- Downloads: PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG and print-ready PDF (HD, 4K and exact-size cm options)
- Logo support: error correction switches to Level H (30%) automatically when a logo is added
- Live scan check: a built-in decoder test-scans every design before download
- Design: colors, gradients, dot and corner styles, ready-made themes, poster frames with a call-to-action
- Privacy: generated locally in the browser; no account and no server storage

## Generators
- [QR code generator with logo](https://qrvibe.online/qr-code-generator-with-logo): add a brand logo to the center of a QR code
- [WhatsApp QR code generator](https://qrvibe.online/whatsapp-qr-code-generator): opens a WhatsApp chat with an optional pre-filled message
- [Wi-Fi QR code generator](https://qrvibe.online/wifi-qr-code-generator): guests join Wi-Fi by scanning, no password typing
- [Business card QR code generator](https://qrvibe.online/qr-code-for-business-cards): vCard QR that saves your contact in one tap
- [Instagram QR code generator](https://qrvibe.online/instagram-qr-code-generator): branded QR codes for Instagram profiles, posts and reels
- [Google review QR code generator](https://qrvibe.online/google-review-qr-code-generator): opens your Google Business review form in one scan
- [Restaurant menu QR code generator](https://qrvibe.online/menu-qr-code-generator): contactless menu QR codes for restaurants and cafes
- [Free QR code generator that never expires](https://qrvibe.online/free-qr-code-generator-no-expiry): static QR codes with no sign-up, watermark, scan limit or subscription
- [Custom QR code generator](https://qrvibe.online/custom-qr-code-generator): custom colors, dots, corners and frames
- [SMS QR code generator](https://qrvibe.online/sms-qr-code-generator): opens the messages app with number and text pre-filled
- [Phone call QR code generator](https://qrvibe.online/phone-call-qr-code-generator): opens the dialer with your number
- [Location QR code generator](https://qrvibe.online/location-qr-code-generator): opens Google Maps or a map app at exact coordinates
- [Calendar event QR code generator](https://qrvibe.online/event-qr-code-generator): adds an event to the phone calendar
- [Social media QR code generator](https://qrvibe.online/social-media-qr-code-generator): Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, Telegram and X profile QR codes
- [Bulk QR code generator](https://qrvibe.online/bulk-qr-code-generator): up to 200 QR codes from a list or CSV, downloaded as a ZIP
- [QR code scanner](https://qrvibe.online/qr-code-scanner): scan with a camera or an uploaded image, entirely in the browser
